name: Speciality Restaurants Ltd
title: Speciality Restaurants Ltd - 534425 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Restaurant chain with asset-light-ish growth: 32 new outlets planned in FY27 (INR37 cr capex), SSG 2.25% in Q4 and 11.57% in April, but ~4% price hike only and LPG-to-induction switch under way.

capex.quote: this year itself, we have scheduled to la unch 8 new restaurants, 15 new Walters and 10 new Sweet Bengals

triggers.label: April SSSG 11.57% vs Q4 2.25%
triggers.quote: in the month of April, we have an S SG of 11.57%

triggers.label: Price hike only 4%, held back
triggers.quote: we've just taken a 4% price rise

guidance.value: ~15%, top line closer to INR600 crore

guidance.metric: EBITDA growth vs revenue growth FY27
guidance.value: EBITDA to grow 15-16% in line with revenue
guidance.quote: we would be able to improve to the extent of 15%, 16% over a percentage increase on EBITDA numbers
we have scheduled to la unch 8 new restaurants, 15 new Walters and 10 new Sweet Bengals
it is going to be double digit going forward

red_flags.label: Revenue guidance vs cash-flow EBITDA gap
red_flags.quote: we did close to INR80 -odd crores of CFO and I deduct the INR50 -odd crores of rental expenses

red_flags.label: Restaurant-level vs company EBITDA confusion
red_flags.quote: We are doing 15% on restaurant level basis, sir, post the rentals.

evasions.topic: Corporate EBITDA margin vs restaurant margin
evasions.quote: Sorry I think when we are talking in terms of 15%, 16%, this is on the restaurant level basis.
Point taken, I presume this may be taken up by the Board members only.
